ui_label: Horizontal grid cell with a linear spectral gaussian grid type and 1.875 x 1.875 degree resolution.
description: **Atmospheric Model Horizontal Grid Description:** The atmospheric component utilizes a standard T62 Gaussian grid resulting from spectral truncation. It features a uniform horizontal resolution of 1.875° in longitude (192 grid points across 0°–360°E) and an approximate 1.875° spacing in latitude (94 Gaussian latitude points spanning from pole to pole). The global horizontal grid consists of a 192 × 94 array, yielding a total of 18,048 grid cells with an effective spatial resolution of approximately 200 km.
